description: Defines the M2MRelationship class for managing many-to-many relationships in SuiteCRM, including methods for adding, removing, and querying relationships, as well as handling relationship metadata and security considerations.

classes.name: M2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a many-to-many relationship in SuiteCRM, providing methods for relationship management including add, remove, load, and query functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object with relationship definitions and links for left and right modules.

methods.name: getLinkedDefForModuleByRelationship
methods.description: Finds the link definition for a specific module within the relationship.

methods.name: getMostAppropriateLinkedDefinition
methods.description: Selects the most suitable link definition when multiple are available.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling security groups and self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: getRowToInsert
methods.description: Prepares a data row for inserting a new relationship record.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a relationship between two beans, considering security groups and self-referencing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related beans via a relationship link.

methods.name: linkIsLHS
methods.description: Determines if the link is on the left-hand side.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve related beans.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Constructs SQL JOIN statements for relationship queries.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Builds a subpanel SQL query for related beans.

methods.name: getRoleFilterForJoin
methods.description: Generates role-based filter conditions for JOINs.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship exists between two beans.

methods.name: getAlternateKeyFields
methods.description: Returns fields that uniquely identify a relationship record.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the relationship table.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used in the relationship table.
